name: Nanase Izuki
source:
Position: Soldier
Weapon: Whip

The person who brought the protagonists team together. A 'Great Tenshi'.
He has a calm temperament and is basically a gentle person, but even though he is older he has really extreme reactions to love situations.
Being the only person in the team with prior experience, rather then just sending the team off he's the type that participates in the missions.
translation:
Position: Soldier
Weapon: Whip

The person who brought the protagonists team together. A 'Great Tenshi'.
He has a calm temperament and is basically a gentle person, but even though he is older he has really extreme reactions to love situations.
Being the only person in the team with prior experience, rather then just sending the team off he's the type that participates in the missions.
